messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Meloxicam can increase your risk of a fatal heart attack or stroke.
This risk is especially high if you use it long term.
The risk is also higher if you take high doses.
The risk is further increased if you have heart disease.
Even people without heart disease or risk factors could have a stroke or heart attack while taking this medicine.
Do not use this medicine just before or after heart bypass surgery (coronary artery bypass graft, or CABG).
Avoid taking meloxicam after a recent heart attack, unless your doctor tells you to.
You may have an increased risk of another heart attack if you take this medicine after a recent heart attack.
Get emergency medical help if you have chest pain, weakness, shortness of breath, slurred speech, or problems with vision or balance.
Meloxicam may also cause stomach or intestinal bleeding.
This bleeding can be fatal.
These conditions can occur without warning while you are using this medicine, especially in older adults.
Call your doctor at once if you have symptoms of stomach bleeding.
These symptoms include black, bloody, or tarry stools.
Triplet: ["Meloxicam", "should be avoided after", "recent heart attack"]

The relation 'should be avoided after' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug should not be taken following the event or condition specified by the object entity, unless otherwise directed by a healthcare provider.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
B. 'should be avoided during': The subject drug should not be used during the time period specified by the object entity.
C. 'not administered via': The subject drug should not be given using the route or method specified by the object entity.
D. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
E. 'has maximum dose': The subject drug should not exceed the maximum dose specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
